global_flags.summary: Credential name to use for the Vercel request.

global_flags.name: connection
global_flags.summary: Credential alias used only when --credential is omitted.

global_flags.name: config
global_flags.summary: Connector config override as key=value; never pass secret values here.

global_flags.name: plan
global_flags.summary: Execute an approved reverse-ETL plan by id.

global_flags.name: preview
global_flags.summary: Preview a reverse-ETL write command without making a network mutation.

global_flags.name: approval-token-stdin
global_flags.summary: Read the approval token as one bounded line from standard input.

commands.summary: Read Vercel projects through the declared ETL stream.
Plan an update to a Vercel project through reverse ETL.
commands.risk: Updates a Vercel project; requires reverse-ETL plan, preview, explicit approval, then execute.
commands.approval: Plan first, inspect preview output, then run only with the generated approval token.
examples: pm vercel projects update --credential vercel-prod --id prj_fixture_1 --name fixture-app --preview --json

help_topics.name: execution-model
help_topics.summary: Reverse ETL uses plan, preview, approval, and execute; provider-live certification remains pending.
